packs.name: domino-operator
packs.values:
pack:
  spectrocloud.com/install-priority: "5"
apiVersion: operator.domino.ai/v1beta1
kind: Domino
metadata:
  name: domino
  namespace: domino-operator
spec:
  agent:
    spec:
      containerSecurityContext:
        allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
        capabilities:
          drop:
            - ALL
        readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: domino-quay-repos
      nodeSelector:
        dominodatalab.com/node-pool: platform
      repository: <AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>.dkr.ecr.us-gov-west-1.amazonaws.com/<ECR_PREFIX>/domino/fleetcommand-agent
      resources:
        limits:
          cpu: "4"
          memory: 1500Mi
        requests:
          cpu: "4"
          memory: 1500Mi
      retryLimit: 1
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        seLinuxOptions:
          type: spc_t
      serviceAccountName: platform-operator
      version: 6.2.2.catalog-34a6626
  catalog: {}
  clusterId: domino-flat
  config: |
    autoscaler:
      auto_discovery:
        cluster_name: domino-flat
        tags: []
      aws:
        region: us-gov-west-1
      cloud_provider: aws
    blob_storage:
      backups:
        s3:
          bucket: domino-flat-backups-<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>-us-gov-west-1
          region: us-gov-west-1
          sse_kms_key_id: <KMS_KEY_ID>
      logs:
        s3:
          bucket: domino-flat-logs-<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>-us-gov-west-1
          region: us-gov-west-1
          sse_kms_key_id: <KMS_KEY_ID>
      projects:
        s3:
          bucket: domino-flat-projects-<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>-us-gov-west-1
          region: us-gov-west-1
          sse_kms_key_id: <KMS_KEY_ID>
    email_notifications:
      authentication:
        password: ""
        username: ""
      enable_ssl: true
      enabled: false
      from_address: CHANGE_ME@customer.org
      port: 465
      server: _CHANGE_ME_
    external_deployments:
      cluster_config:
        eks:
          aws_account_id: "<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>"
          operator_role_arn: arn:aws-us-gov:iam::<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>:role/domino-flat-operator
          operator_service_account_name: domino-operator
      enabled: true
    external_docker_registry: <AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>.dkr.ecr.us-gov-west-1.amazonaws.com/<ECR_PREFIX>
    flyte:
      cluster_config:
        eks:
          aws_account_id: "<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>"
          controlplane_role_arn: arn:aws-us-gov:iam::<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>:role/domino-flat-flyte-cp
          dataplane_role_arn: arn:aws-us-gov:iam::<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>:role/domino-flat-flyte-dp
      data_storage:
        s3:
          bucket: domino-flat-flyte-data-<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>-us-gov-west-1
          region: us-gov-west-1
          sse_kms_key_id: <KMS_KEY_ID>
      metadata_storage:
        s3:
          bucket: domino-flat-flyte-meta-<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>-us-gov-west-1
          region: us-gov-west-1
          sse_kms_key_id: <KMS_KEY_ID>
    gpu:
      enabled: false
    helm:
      image_registries:
        - password: "__NODE_ROLE_OR_PULL_SECRET__"
          server: <AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>.dkr.ecr.us-gov-west-1.amazonaws.com/<ECR_PREFIX>
          username: AWS
    hostname: domino.flat.local
    metrics_server:
      install: false
    monitoring:
      prometheus_metrics: true
    name: domino-flat
    schema: "1.16"
    storage_classes:
      block:
        access_modes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        base_path: ""
        create: false
        name: dominodisk
        type: ebs
      shared:
        access_modes:
          - ReadWriteMany
        create: true
        efs:
          access_point_id: fsap-0ef7a8695e14120e7
          filesystem_id: fs-0b4c353e97ae4d0af
          region: us-gov-west-1
        name: dominoshared
        type: efs
        volume_capacity: 5Ti
    telemetry:
      mixpanel: {}
    version: 6.2.2
    certificate_management:
      install: false
    release_overrides:
      cluster-autoscaler:
        installed: false
  interval: 6h0m0s
  version: 6.2.2
